{#- Custom language switcher for sphinx-book-theme. Renders three links pointing at sibling language subdirs (..//...). The current language's link is marked aria-current="page" and styled to indicate the active language. We compute the relative path back to the build/html/ root by prepending "../" once per directory component in the current page's name, plus one extra "../" to climb out of the language subdir itself. From there we descend into the target language and link to its index page. Build all three languages and the switcher resolves correctly for every page depth. -#}
{%- set current_lang = language|default("en") -%} {%- set langs = [("en", "EN"), ("fr", "FR"), ("de", "DE")] -%} {#- depth = number of "/" in pagename; add 1 to also exit the lang subdir -#} {%- set depth = pagename.split("/")|length -%} {%- set root = "../" * depth -%} {%- for code, label in langs -%} {%- if code == current_lang -%} {{ label }} {%- else -%} {{ label }} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%}
